case_reviews.assessment: The ordinary named Polypeptone preparation retains its local identity and is a supported kind of the closer generic MeSH Peptones material category. Full MICRO179 defines the BD casein/animal-tissue blend; it cannot supply exact identity for bare MediaDive442 or Hipolypepton2060. Three BD catalogue labels correctly become nonresolving provenance, retaining exact text/source prefixes, while five earlier Japanese/Hipolypepton exclusions remain exact. This does not prove every product chemically distinct. Current notes explicitly supersede earlier self-only/pending/FoodOn-gate conclusions. Complete history, 135/135 historical counts, provisional role, source/product/quantity holds and supplied-form boundaries are preserved. Mapping is NARROW_MATCH emitting broadMatch plus local identity, with truthful LLM evidence and no BD formula or lot-property assertion.
case_reviews.limitations: Existing source case raw form, original occurrence scope, generic-product/Japanese version and M122 quantity holds remain unchanged. This does not admit the Hipolypepton source to the Polypeptone owner.
